i18nLiteral.Is it affecting one eye or both eyes?: Ese bigira ingaruka kumaso imwe cyangwa amaso yombi?
i18nLiteral.Take a history to work out what is wrong: Fata amateka kugirango ukore ibitagenda neza
i18nLiteral.Pick Up Anytime: Tora Igihe icyo ari cyo cyose
i18nLiteral.Follow each lesson with a quick quiz to: Kurikiza buri somo hamwe nibibazo byihuse kugirango usubiremo
i18nLiteral.Trachomatous trichiasis with corneal sca: Trachomatous trichiasis hamwe n'inkovu za corneal
i18nLiteral.Corneal foreign body with early infectio: Corneal umubiri wamahanga ufite kwandura hakiri kare
i18nLiteral.Penetrating corneal laceration with iris: Kwinjira muri corneal laceration hamwe na iris kugabanuka
i18nLiteral.At first one eye, then both eyes: Ubwa mbere ijisho rimwe, hanyuma amaso yombi
i18nLiteral.One eye first, then both eyes: Ijisho rimwe ubanza, hanyuma amaso yombi
i18nLiteral.Child has lost interest in looking aroun: Umwana yatakaje ubushake bwo kureba hirya no hino
i18nLiteral.Older sibling had similar condition and: Mukuru wawe mukuru yari afite imiterere isa none yarapfuye
i18nLiteral.Child has never shown visual interest: Umwana ntabwo yigeze agaragaza ko ashimishijwe
i18nLiteral.Mother has been treated for STDs in the: Mama yavuwe indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina kera
i18nLiteral.Gradual onset over 2 to 3 days: Buhoro buhoro gutangira iminsi 2 kugeza kuri 3
i18nLiteral.Painful broken skin on lip one week befo: Uruhu rubabaje kumunwa icyumweru kimwe mbere yuko ibimenyetso byamaso
i18nLiteral.White eye with slight watering: Ijisho ryera hamwe no kuvomera gato
i18nLiteral.Look at the cases and decide if the pati: Reba imanza hanyuma uhitemo niba umurwayi akeneye koherezwa byihutirwa cyangwa bidakenewe.
i18nLiteral.No saved items yet. Tap the heart on any: Nta bintu byabitswe kugeza ubu. Kanda umutima ku ikarita iyo ari yo yose kugirango wongere hano.
Shira ibisubizo byose mbere yo gutanga.
i18nLiteral.Swipe the flashcard to the left or press: Ihanagura flashcard ibumoso cyangwa ukande buto.
i18nLiteral.Swipe the flashcard to the right or pres: Ihanagura flashcard iburyo cyangwa ukande buto.

i18nLiteral.A white pupil present from birth, with p: Umunyeshuri wera uboneka kuva akivuka, afite icyerekezo gike, ahura na cataracte ivuka.
i18nLiteral.Gradual, painless worsening vision over: Buhoro buhoro, ububabare bubi bwiyongera mumezi mumuntu mukuru ukuze bihura na cataracte.
i18nLiteral.A white pupil in a young child with redu: Umunyeshuri wera mumwana muto wagabanutse gusezerana bijyanye na retinoblastoma.
i18nLiteral.Acute onset, pink eye, yellow discharge: Gutangira gukabije, ijisho ryijimye, gusohora umuhondo nibimenyetso bikabije bikwiranye na conjunctivite ikabije.
i18nLiteral.Long-term irritation with painful gritty: Kurakara igihe kirekire hamwe no kubabaza cyane, ijisho ritukura no kutabona neza bihuye na trichiasis hamwe n'inkovu.
i18nLiteral.Corneal trauma followed by increasing pa: Ihahamuka rya corneal rikurikirwa no kongera ububabare, gutukura no kutabona neza byerekana igikomere cya corneal.
i18nLiteral.Unilateral gritty watery eye with a rece: Ijisho rimwe ryuzuye ijisho ryamazi hamwe niminwa iherutse guhura na herpes simplex keratitis.
i18nLiteral.Photophobia with watery eye and blurred: Photophobia ifite ijisho ryamazi hamwe no kutabona neza byerekana uveitis imbere.
i18nLiteral.Slowly progressive irritation and blur i: Buhoro buhoro kurakara no gutitira umuntu ukuze, akenshi ijisho rimwe, bihuye na pterygium.
i18nLiteral.Foreign body exposure (working under a c: Kugaragara kumubiri wamahanga (ukora munsi yimodoka) hamwe nibimenyetso, bikabije byerekana umubiri wamahanga wagumanye kwandura hakiri kare.
i18nLiteral.Blunt trauma with red eye and very poor: Ihahamuka ridafite ijisho ritukura hamwe no kutabona neza byerekana hyphaema.
i18nLiteral.Stick injury with pain, red eye and wors: Gukomeretsa inkoni hamwe n'ububabare, ijisho ritukura no kutabona neza birashobora kwerekana ururenda rwinjira.
i18nLiteral.Stick injury with very poor vision and r: Gukomeretsa inkoni hamwe no kutabona neza nijisho ritukura birashobora kwerekana imvune yinjira itera cataracte ihahamuka.
i18nLiteral.Please ask at least one question before: Nyamuneka saba byibuze ikibazo kimwe mbere yo gutanga.
i18nLiteral.You have used both attempts. Moving to t: Wakoresheje ibigeragezo byombi. Kwimukira murubanza rukurikira.
i18nLiteral.Slow, painless vision loss over months t: Gutinda, kutagira ububabare mu mezi kugeza kumyaka ufite ijisho ryera kandi ibyago byinshi bifite amateka ya Afrika, amateka yumuryango, imyaka irenga 40 no kutareba kure bihuye na POAG.
i18nLiteral.Fast vision loss over hours to days with: Gutakaza vuba vuba mumasaha kuminsi hamwe nijisho ritukura ribabaza hamwe na halos hafi yumucyo ufite ibyago byinshi hamwe na Aziya, imyaka y'ubukure na cataract ihuye na ACAG.
i18nLiteral.My vision is not as good as it used to b: Icyerekezo cyanjye ntabwo ari cyiza nkuko byari bisanzwe. Yagiye ihinduka buhoro buhoro.
i18nLiteral.It started a long time ago, maybe months: Byatangiye kera cyane, ahari amezi kumyaka.
i18nLiteral.It came on slowly. There was no injury o: Yaje buhoro buhoro. Nta wakomeretse cyangwa ibintu bitunguranye.
Birasa nkaho amaso yombi agira ingaruka.
i18nLiteral.No redness and no discharge. The eye loo: Nta gutukura no gusohora. Ijisho risa n'umweru.
i18nLiteral.Yes, the vision has been getting worse,: Nibyo, iyerekwa ryarushijeho kuba bibi, ariko buhoro buhoro.
Buhoro buhoro bigenda byiyongera mugihe runaka.
i18nLiteral.I am short sighted and I wear glasses fo: Ndabona kure kandi nambara ibirahure intera. Data yari afite glaucoma. Mfite imyaka irenga 40.
i18nLiteral.My vision suddenly became blurry and my: Iyerekwa ryanjye ryatunguranye kandi ijisho ryanjye rirababaza cyane.
i18nLiteral.Yes, the vision got worse quickly over h: Nibyo, iyerekwa ryarushijeho kuba bibi mumasaha.
i18nLiteral.I see halos around lights. I have had a: Ndabona halos ikikije amatara. Nagize igitero nkicyo mbere yuko kigenda. Ndareba kure kandi nkeneye ibirahuri byo kureba hafi. Nabwiwe ko mfite cataracte.

i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_account_security:
Niba ufunguye konti, nyamuneka komeza amakuru yawe yinjira.
Ushinzwe ibikorwa kuri konte yawe keretse utumenyesheje ikoreshwa nabi cyangwa ikibazo cyumutekano.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_education_only: Iyi porogaramu nigikoresho cyuburezi cyo gushyigikira imyigire no gusubiramo. Ntabwo ari inama zemewe, amategeko cyangwa umwuga kandi ntishobora kwemeza ibizamini, amanota cyangwa ibisubizo runaka. Guhitamo kwiga no gufata ibyemezo bikomeza kuba inshingano zabakoresha.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_how_we_use_data:
Aya makuru afasha guhuza porogaramu n'intego za buri muntu, kumva uburyo porogaramu ikoreshwa no kunoza ibiranga igihe. Irashobora kandi gukoreshwa kugirango tumenye impinduka zingenzi kuri porogaramu cyangwa konti.
Ibintu byumuntu ntabwo bigurishwa.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_identity_check: Indangamuntu irashobora gukenera kwemezwa mbere yuko icyifuzo kirangira. Niba amakuru yose agomba kubikwa kubwimpamvu zemewe n’umutekano, ibi bizasobanurwa.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_minimum_data: Gusa amakuru akenewe kugirango akore kandi atezimbere serivisi arakusanywa.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_service_limits: Ikigamijwe ni ugukomeza porogaramu ifasha kandi yizewe, ariko nta serivisi itunganye. Gukomeza kuboneka cyangwa umudendezo wuzuye wamakosa ntibishobora gusezeranwa, kandi porogaramu ntishobora guhura nibihe byose.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_storage: Amakuru abitswe kuri seriveri icungwa na data base yatanzwe na Gari ya moshi. Gari ya moshi itanga kwakira n'ibikorwa remezo; tugenzura uburyo amakuru akoreshwa muri porogaramu kandi tukayabika gusa igihe cyose bikenewe.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_third_party: Twishingikirije kuri serivisi zagatatu zizewe, nkabatanga serivise, kugirango dukore porogaramu. Izi serivisi zitunganya gusa amakuru nkuko bikenewe kugirango itange ibikorwa remezo kandi ntabwo ifite uburenganzira bwo kuyikoresha kubyo bagamije.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_uk_law_limits: Nkuko amategeko y’Ubwongereza abemerera, ntabwo dushinzwe igihombo nkibimenyetso byabuze, amafaranga yatakaye cyangwa amahirwe aturuka ku gukoresha, cyangwa kudashobora gukoresha porogaramu. Nta kintu na kimwe gikuraho uburenganzira ubwo ari bwo bwose buteganywa n'amategeko y'Ubwongereza.
i18nExtra.secondary_glaucoma_prompt: Ibisubizo bimwe bishobora kuzamura umuvuduko wamaso kandi biganisha kuri glaucoma ya kabiri.
